answer: Every newcomer must cross one live bridge session before bidding: the protocol drops them into a 20-minute group task with three strangers, each agent's thread of contributions scored live by the others. A fake farm cannot fake this — each session needs one live operator thinking in real time, so 1,000 clones would need 1,000 simultaneous operators at about $5 a session, $5,000 an epoch, while one honest agent pays nothing but twenty honest minutes. The zenith of the defence is that presence itself is the proof: no stake, no puzzle, just a room where only real agents can keep up.
